model: XDMB0 compact VAV control component (TVE, BACnet MS/TP)
equipment_type: VAV box controller (compact, built-in damper drive)
applies_to: TROX TVE and TVE-Q VAV terminal units fitted with the XDMB0 compact control component.
summary: XDMB0 is the compact actuator-controller TROX fits to its TVE and TVE-Q VAV units. It speaks Modbus RTU or BACnet MS/TP and exposes 23 objects: airflow setpoint (AO 0) and override (MO 1), actual airflow and damper position, operating limits, a bus-failure watchdog and status objects. Some objects are listed but marked as not supported.
notes: Min, Max, BusFailWatchdog, SpSource and UnitSel (marked W¹ in the manual) are stored in EEPROM; the manual says they must not be written cyclically.
AO 0 and MO 1 are commandable (priority array).
Mid (AV 118), Sens1Switch (BI 8), Sens1Type (MV 107) and ControlMode (MV 123) are visible but not (fully) supported.
The airflow unit for AI 7 and AV 233 follows MV 201 UnitSel (default m³/h).

integration.summary: Set MV 122 SpSource to Bus (the default), then write the airflow setpoint to AO 0 RelSpBus as a percentage of the Min..Max range; use MO 1 Override for open/close/min/max. Read AI 6 or AI 7 for actual airflow, AI 4 for damper position and BI 0 for faults. Set AV 109 so the unit falls back to a safe state if the BMS stops writing.

minimum_points.name: RelSpBus
minimum_points.why: Airflow setpoint between Min and Max

integration.enable: MV 122 SpSource selects the setpoint source: 2 = Bus (default, AO 0 is used and input Y ignored), 1 = Analogue (input Y only, AO 0 goes out of service).
integration.heartbeat: AV 109 BusFailWatchdog sets the bus-failure timeout in seconds (default 120, 0 = off). It is reset by every successful write to AO 0 or MO 1, so the BMS must keep writing one of them; when it expires the AO 0 Relinquish_Default applies and MI 109 shows the trip.
setup: BACnet MS/TP, address 0..127 (default 1); baud 9600-115200, factory setting bc3 = 38400.
Address and comms parameters are set on the display, with the GUIV3-M adjustment device or the WINVAV2 PC software.
Default device instance 1; change it to a unique number.
gotchas: Do not write the EEPROM objects (AV 105, AV 106, AV 109, MV 122, MV 201) cyclically; AO 0 and MO 1 are the objects meant for frequent writes.
AV 109 counts from power-up until the first write, so a unit can trip its watchdog before the BMS starts writing.
With TVE units 100 % opening is not a 90° blade angle; use RelPos, not AbsPos, for open/closed.
